card.name: Scattered mid-sentence linking words
card.fires_on: No single word or setting; it fires on assorted small words (of, and, there, a, one) and a few nouns in varied prose and label text.

modes.label: Small linking words
modes.description: Short words like of, and, there, a, or a comma inside a sentence before a noun phrase.
modes.example: A Dies Irae sung in the style<< of>> an eager four-year-old, for example

modes.label: Heading-like nouns
modes.description: Nouns in table or heading text such as Clinical or Hip.
modes.example: Digoxin<< Clinical>> Impact: When multiple doses of ator

card.plain: It reacts to scattered everyday words in the middle of sentences, with no pattern a clinician could rely on.
